# Usage

Run everything from the project root, with `--extra dev` so the type checkers are actually on `PATH` inside uv's environment.

```bash
# full pipeline: mine -> generate -> filter -> evaluate
uv run --extra dev pytifex --model command-a-03-2025

# stop once you've found N disagreements
uv run --extra dev pytifex --model command-a-03-2025 --num-examples 10

# a local model behind an OpenAI-compatible server
uv run --extra dev pytifex --model qwen3-6b --openai-base-url http://localhost:8080/v1

# the real OpenAI API
uv run --extra dev pytifex --model gpt-4o --openai-base-url https://api.openai.com/v1

# skip GitHub seed fetching, generate from patterns instead
uv run --extra dev pytifex --model command-a-03-2025 --no-github

# verbose output
uv run --extra dev pytifex --model command-a-03-2025 -v
```

## Commands

| Command | Does |
|---------|------|
| `uv run --extra dev pytifex` | full pipeline (generate + evaluate) |
| `uv run --extra dev pytifex generate` | generate disagreements only |
| `uv run --extra dev pytifex check` | run the type checkers on examples that already exist |
| `uv run --extra dev pytifex eval` | evaluate results that already exist |

## Options

| Option | Default | Does |
|--------|---------|------|
| `--num-examples N` | `5` | target number of disagreements to find |
| `--batch-size N` | `15` | examples generated per LLM call |
| `--max-attempts N` | `5` | generation rounds before giving up |
| `--max-refinements N` | `2` | refinement passes per example that didn't diverge |
| `--model MODEL` | `gemini-2.5-flash` (pending removal — always pass this explicitly) | model name, see providers below |
| `--openai-base-url URL` | — | base URL for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint |
| `--eval-method METHOD` | `comprehensive` | evaluation method |
| `--no-github` | — | skip GitHub seed mining |
| `-v, --verbose` | — | show every example, not just the disagreements |

## Providers

The provider is picked automatically from `--model` and `--openai-base-url` — there's no separate `--provider` flag.

### OpenAI-compatible

Triggered by passing `--openai-base-url`, regardless of model name. Works with real OpenAI, [llama-server](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp), Ollama, vLLM, or any server speaking `/v1/chat/completions`.

```bash
# real OpenAI
export OPENAI_API_KEY=your_key
uv run --extra dev pytifex --model gpt-4o --openai-base-url https://api.openai.com/v1

# a local model, no key needed unless the server requires one
uv run --extra dev pytifex --model qwen3-6b --openai-base-url http://localhost:8080/v1

# Ollama
uv run --extra dev pytifex --model llama3 --openai-base-url http://localhost:11434/v1
```

If `OPENAI_API_KEY` isn't set and the server doesn't require auth, that's fine — it gets sent as an empty string.

### Cohere

Needs `COHERE_API_KEY` or `CO_API_KEY`, triggered by any `command-*` model name.

```bash
uv run --extra dev pytifex --model command-a-03-2025
uv run --extra dev pytifex --model command-r-plus-08-2024
```

If you leave both `--model` and `--openai-base-url` unset, the CLI currently falls back to Gemini internally — that's a leftover default that's going away, not a supported path. Always pass one of the two options above.

## What a run looks like

```
============================================================
PYTIFEX - Full Pipeline (with disagreement filtering)
============================================================

[STEP 1/2] Generating examples with disagreement filtering...
Target: 2 disagreement examples
Using model: command-a-03-2025

[Attempt 1/5] Generating batch of 15...
  Using 5 GitHub issue seeds
  Parsed 19 examples, running type checkers...
  ✓ generic-typevar-bound: DISAGREEMENT {'mypy': 'ok', 'pyrefly': 'ok', 'zuban': 'error', 'ty': 'ok'}
  ✓ self-in-protocol:      DISAGREEMENT {'mypy': 'error', 'pyrefly': 'error', 'zuban': 'error', 'ty': 'ok'}
  Progress: 2/2 disagreements found

GENERATION COMPLETE: 2 disagreements from 19 total examples
```

## If something goes wrong

**No disagreements found** — try `--max-attempts` or `--batch-size` higher, or a more capable model.

**GitHub rate limit errors** — set `GITHUB_TOKEN`, or just run with `--no-github`.

**"command not found" for a type checker** — you forgot `--extra dev`. Without it, `uv run pytifex` only installs pytifex's own two dependencies, not the checkers. Re-run with `uv run --extra dev pytifex ...`.

**Local server not responding** — make sure the server process is actually up and the port in `--openai-base-url` matches. Double-check `--model` matches exactly what the server's `/v1/models` endpoint calls it — a mismatch there is the most common cause of a 404.
